name: Spreadsheet Cinema
summary: The frame is a live spreadsheet: the selection is the camera, the formula bar is the subtitle track and Pulse is a dashed teal selection scanning every row.
look: Full-bleed spreadsheet with formula bar, column/row headers and sheet tabs on warm off-white. Headlines sit in merged cell ranges, the logo is drawn in filled cell-pixels, and the anomaly is a coral conditional-format cell with an error triangle and a cell note.

components.name: Conditional tint + error triangle + cell note
components.role: the anomaly and its alert card

motion.name: Marquee morph
motion.how: selection resizes and jumps ranges, expo.inOut 0.35 s, lands on a beat

motion.name: Fill-handle cascade
motion.how: values fill down row by row, stagger 0.015 s, one column per beat

motion.name: Cell-pixel reveal
motion.how: random-seeded pixel fills over 0.6 s, final coral pixel on the 0:08 drop

story: Hook: a merged-range headline asks how many dashboards you checked while the TOTAL cell flips to 38 and tabs overflow. Reveal: the grid zooms out and teal cell-pixels draw the pulse line into the Acme Pulse lockup. Proof: Pulse's dashed selection scans the metric table, stops on checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231, and a cell note offers Roll back, which the human clicks. CTA: lockup in a merged range, 'You ship. Pulse watches.', a coral Start free cell.
adapt: Swap the rows for your own records or metrics and put your product's function in the formula bar; the dashed selection becomes whatever your product automates.

references.note: animating inside Google Sheets, cell-fill tricks

fit.risk: gridlines turn into noise at feed size; frame 6-8 columns and keep headlines in merged ranges
